programs.name: SPL Token (classic)
programs.selection_reason: First-party SPL program; deliberately non-Anchor to detect Anchor-shaped bias in the 'pull' definition
programs.notes: Native (non-Anchor) program whose instruction layouts are fixed by the SPL interface, not by an on-chain Anchor IDL account. A 'usable IDL pulled' verdict for this program must be manually verified: it would mean the harness accepted a non-IDL schema. Counted in the 20-denominator; report numerator both with and without controls.

expected_reporting.below_50_percent_action: If <50% (i.e. <10/20 or <9/18), README hypothesis must be explicitly revised; no cherry-picking allowed; every one of the 20 programs stays in the denominator unless a program id is proven wrong on-chain.
